author: bardic-inspiration
name: Boots of the Soft Hours
summary: Boots that let you walk without a sound.
description: Burglars say they were left by someone who never wanted to be heard. They have been resoled many times.

stats.effect: While you wear these boots, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently, and your steps leave no tracks you don't wish to leave.
